title: Phylogeny and reproductive strategy
legend: The original topology-only tree and reproductive-strategy symbols for the 21 species shared by the genomic and cellular-trait panels. Species labels retain the collage order. Branch lengths and a time scale are omitted because the source tree's publication, calibration, and time provenance remain unresolved.
alt_text: Topology-only phylogeny with 21 italic species labels and reproductive-strategy symbols.

title: Estimated genome size
legend: Estimated genome sizes (pg/1C*) derived from IOD and anchored to the D. fuscus assembly, with 95% measurement-bootstrap intervals. One common circle symbol is used and each estimate is labelled to one decimal place. The 8-27 pg/1C axis retains every interval. These are not independent species C-values; intervals exclude anchor uncertainty and remain conditional on observed image and animal support. Support cautions are retained in S24 rather than encoded by changing point symbols.
alt_text: Twenty-one labelled species with uniform circular genome-size points, one-decimal estimate labels, and measurement intervals on an 8-27 pg/1C axis.

title: Broad TE composition
legend: Broad TE-order shares of classified dnaPipeTE aligned bases for the same 21 species. LTR, LINE, TIR, and Other retain the collage's category colours and common 0-100% scale. These are composition fractions within the assay, not genome occupancy.
alt_text: Twenty-one labelled horizontal stacked bars show LTR, LINE, TIR, and Other composition shares.

title: TE superfamilies
legend: The same nine abundant dnaPipeTE superfamilies in the same numbered positions and species order. Every row's miniature bars share the original 0-70% classified-aligned-base scale, from the bottom to the top of its frame. The numbered legend identifies every family; the selected subset is not renormalized.
alt_text: Twenty-one labelled rows each contain nine coloured superfamily bars on a common zero-to-70-percent scale.

title: Repeat divergence profiles
legend: The original 63 LTR, LINE, and TIR RepeatMasker profiles, with every row labelled by species. Each profile retains 0-50% sequence divergence in 1-percentage-point bins and 0-3% of all RepeatMasker-aligned hit bp for that species, from the bottom to the top of its frame. Absent order/bin combinations are zero-filled without subset renormalization. The denominator differs from dnaPipeTE composition. Divergence is not insertion age, and hit-bp fractions are not genome occupancy.
alt_text: Twenty-one labelled rows each contain LTR, LINE, and TIR divergence profiles with shared divergence and abundance scales.
